title: Purchases page: all odds as tables, trim the prose
thread:
**Issue #3188 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #3188: Purchases page: all odds as tables, trim the prose Opened by @squishy-squooby. ## What Rewrite the `/purchases` page (`apps/web/src/routes/purchases.tsx`, `purchases.css`) so that every odds figure is in a table, and cut the long prose. Implement the copy and the table layout below **verbatim**. The percentages shown below are today's shipped config values, included only as a reference. **The page must keep rendering whatever the server returns** (CLAUDE.md rule 7: the client computes nothing). The data comes from `GET /api/packs` (`odds.slot`, `odds.flooredSlot`, `odds.duplicateCosmetic`, `odds.globalCosmetic`, `pity`, `thresholds`, `price`, `slots`) and from `GET /api/cosmetic-packs` (`odds.slot`, `odds.flooredSlot`). Read the pack-summary floors and the cosmetic slot count from the generated wire config (`PACK_FLOOR_RARITY`, `COSMETIC_PACK_SLOTS`, `COSMETIC_PACK_FLOOR_RARITY`), not from hard-coded numbers. A rarity whose value is 0 renders as `—`. ## The page, verbatim **Purchases** You buy packs with Jlore, which you earn by playing. Jlore is never sold for real money. *(signed out)* Sign in to see the odds and your pity counters. **Card packs** 100 Jlore · 5 cards · one card is always Rare or better | Rarity | Each card | Guaranteed card | |---|---|---| | Common | 60% | — | | Rare | 30% | 90% | | Epic | 7% | 7% | | Legendary | 2% | 2% | | Mythic | 1% | 1% | **Duplicates** A card you already own becomes a cosmetic. | Rarity | Cosmetic | Account cosmetic (2% of duplicates) | |---|---|---| | Common | 55% | — | | Rare | 25% | — | | Epic | 15% | 95% | | Legendary | 4.5% | 4.5% | | Mythic | 0.5% | 0.5% | If you already own every cosmetic of that rarity, the duplicate fills both token bars instead. **Cosmetic packs** 5 cosmetics · one is always Epic or better | Rarity | Each slot | Guaranteed slot | |---|---|---| | Common | 55% | — | | Rare | 25% | — | | Epic | 15% | 95% | | Legendary | 4.5% | 4.5% | | Mythic | 0.5% | 0.5% | **Pity** All card packs count toward the same pity. | Rarity | Guaranteed within | Your progress | |---|---|---| | Epic | 10 packs | 7 / 10 | | Legendary | 20 packs | 13 / 20 | | Mythic | 30 packs | 21 / 30 | ## Changes, concretely - **Disclaimer:** replace the current two sentences ("Jlore is earned by playing and never sold… every figure on this page is the server's.") with the single disclaimer line above. - **Card packs:** add the summary line under the heading. In `SlotOdds`, the column headers "Each slot" / "Guaranteed slot" become "Each card" / "Guaranteed card". - **Duplicates:** add a new `

Duplicates

` section. `DuplicateOdds` becomes a table: - Rows: Common through Mythic. - "Cosmetic" column: `odds.duplicateCosmetic`. - "Account cosmetic" column: `odds.globalCosmetic.tiers`. - Column header carries `odds.globalCosmetic.chance` as "(N% of duplicates)". - The token-bars sentence follows as a short paragraph after the table. - **Cosmetic packs:** add the summary line under the heading. `CosmeticOdds` becomes the same three-column table as card packs, with "Each slot" / "Guaranteed slot" columns. - **Pity:** - Keep the one intro line. - Replace the `
    ` with a table: Rarity | Guaranteed within (`thresholds`) | Your progress (`pity` / `thresholds`). - Delete the closing "Pity guarantees an Epic within…" sentence. - **Styling:** every new table reuses the `.purchases-odds` styles. Remove the now-unused `.purchases-pity__list` and `.purchases-pity__row` rules. - **i18n:** replace the removed long sentences with the short strings above. - **Tests:** update `purchases.test.tsx` and `purchasesTestid`. Keep row test ids per rarity for each table (odds, duplicate, cosmetic, pity), and keep the loading, failed and Try again states per section as they are today. ## Check before shipping Confirm the "2% of duplicates" chance and the Epic/Legendary/Mythic split of the account-cosmetic column against a live `GET /api/packs` response. These two figures were inferred from `GLOBAL_COSMETIC_ROLL_WEIGHT` and `GLOBAL_COSMETIC_FLOOR_RARITY`, and the repo's fixtures use different placeholder numbers. Either way, the page shows what the server sends. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_ ```
